otpInput.label: 6-digit code
otpInput.help: Enter the code shown on screen.

upgrade.skipSaveOnly: Skip, I'll just save my Complaint ID
upgrade.mockedOtpTitle: Prototype: OTP is mocked, not a real SMS
upgrade.mockedOtpBody: Demo code: {code}. See <link>what's real vs mocked</link>.
upgrade.linkedBody: You can now check this complaint's status any time at /track.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: You already have an Aadhaar number, so there's nothing to sign up for. Just enter it and we'll find your details and get you started.
signIn.codeDescription: We've sent a 6-digit code to the mobile number on {name}'s record.
signIn.simulatedTitle: Simulated Aadhaar, nothing real is checked
signIn.simulatedBody: This sign-in uses invented Aadhaar records stored in this prototype's own database. Nothing is sent to UIDAI or any government system, and no Aadhaar number is ever attached to a complaint. Only numbers starting 0000 are accepted, so your real number cannot be entered here even by accident. Try 0000 1111 2222.
signIn.aadhaarHelp: 12 digits, beginning 0000. Every demo number is listed on the what's real vs mocked page.
signIn.mockedOtpTitle: Prototype: OTP is mocked, not a real SMS
signIn.mockedOtpBody: Demo code: {code}. It is the same code every time, on purpose, so a live demo is repeatable.

errors.AADHAAR_LENGTH: An Aadhaar number is 12 digits. Please check what you've entered.
errors.AADHAAR_NOT_SIMULATED: That looks like it could be a real Aadhaar number, so we haven't looked it up. This prototype only accepts simulated numbers beginning 0000, try 0000 1111 2222.
errors.AADHAAR_NOT_FOUND: No demo record matches that number. The numbers that work are listed on the what's real vs mocked page.
errors.OTP_MISMATCH: That code didn't match. The demo code is shown just above the box.

signIn.noAadhaarTitle: No Aadhaar number, or not your phone?
signIn.noAadhaarBody: You do not need any of this to report a cyber crime. Call 1930, they take reports by phone, in your own language, and it is faster than any form.
